ox.service.attach.description: Attach an Ox Server service by domain after inspecting its `services/<kind>/<id>/service.json`: `await ox.service.attach({ purpose, domain })`. The first call saves and attaches the service to this conversation; a later call reloads that conversation's attachment from the current service source so a coherent set of Local edits can be tested. Source writes do not reload running attachments. The first attach is allowed by default and respects configured Action policies. If approval is required and the user declines, this throws, so surface that and don't retry blindly. Returns the service snapshot with `reloaded` indicating whether an existing attachment was replaced; a `requireAuth` action revalidates before use. `purpose` is a short (<10 words) human-readable description shown to the user as the step label.

purpose.description: Short (<10 words) description shown to the user as the step label.

ox.service.copy.description: Copy the selected Bundled, Development, or Remote service into the editable Local repository and select that candidate: `await ox.service.copy({ purpose, domain })`. Edit its expanded source under `services/` with `ox.fs`. If a Local copy already exists, inspect ox.repository.conflicts and select that Local candidate with ox.repository.resolve; never overwrite it to resolve a conflict. iOS services are not authorable.

purpose.description: Short (<10 words) description shown to the user as the step label.

ox.service.create.description: Create a Local API service with kind api and a stable domain identifier, a Local web service with `{ purpose, kind: "web", domain }`, or save a remote MCP connection with `{ purpose, kind: "mcp", endpoint, transport?, faviconUrl? }`. faviconUrl is an optional public HTTPS PNG, JPEG, or ICO URL; anonymous loading permits up to five public HTTPS redirects. MCP discovers tools and may request user sign-in before saving it to the Local repository at `services/mcp/<domain>/service.json`; it returns the assigned domain, derived from the endpoint host, for inspect/attach/invoke/delete. An existing endpoint is reused; use update to change its settings or refresh tools. MCP connections save immediately. Never put credentials in the endpoint; use sign-in. This connects to a server, not hosts one.

endpoint.description: Public HTTPS MCP endpoint without credentials. Required for MCP; omit domain.

faviconUrl.description: Optional public HTTPS PNG, JPEG, or ICO URL for this MCP connection.

purpose.description: Short (<10 words) description shown to the user as the step label.

ox.service.delete.description: Delete a Local web service or remove an MCP connection: `await ox.service.delete({ purpose, domain })`. The user approves deletion. Inspect the target source before deleting it and preserve unrelated work. For web services, source deletion is immediate and another repository candidate may become active. There is no built-in version history to restore deleted source. MCP removal is immediate, deletes a Local definition, detaches it from this conversation, clears local authorization and tool approvals, and does not revoke access at the server or delete a non-Local repository definition.

purpose.description: Short (<10 words) description shown to the user as the step label.

ox.service.detach.description: Detach a service (by domain) from this conversation: `await ox.service.detach({ purpose, domain })`. Removes it from the conversation's attachment bar so its actions stop being available; the service stays saved. Use when the user is done with it or you attached the wrong one. Returns the service snapshot (`attached: false`). `purpose` is a short (<10 words) human-readable description shown to the user as the step label.

purpose.description: Short (<10 words) description shown to the user as the step label.

ox.service.find.description: Search the merged service MonoRepository with the same service search used by the app when no attached service covers the task: `await ox.service.find({ purpose, query })`. Returns up to ten ranked matches (domain, kind, manifestPath, repository, repositoryProvenance, name, description, matchedAction, signIn, saved, attached). Read a strong candidate's `manifestPath` when its action contract matters, then bring the best match in with `ox.service.attach({ purpose, domain })`. `purpose` is a short (<10 words) human-readable description shown to the user as the step label.

purpose.description: Short (<10 words) description shown to the user as the step label.

query.description: What the user wants to do, in a few words (e.g. "stream music", "order food").

outputSchema.description: Array of service snapshots, best match first.

ox.service.inspect.description: Inspect one attached service: `await ox.service.inspect({ purpose, domain, actions? })`. Omit `actions` for a compact index of exposed actions. Pass up to ten exposed action IDs to receive their complete, self-contained input and output schemas. Both forms include `signIn`, `botControl`, and `payment` contracts when supported, with the ox.service helper to call, service-specific input schemas, and helper output schemas. Standard URL/state actions are handled by these helpers and cannot be requested in `actions`.

purpose.description: Short (<10 words) description shown to the user as the step label.

outputSchema.description: The attached service snapshot, an action-keyed map of summaries or complete schemas, and supported signIn, botControl, and payment helper contracts. Unsupported helpers are omitted.

ox.service.invoke.description: Invoke a service action: `await ox.service.invoke({ purpose, name, input? })`, where `name` is `web:<domain>:<action>`, `api:<service>:<action>`, `ios:<app>:<action>`, or `mcp:<server>:<action>`. Discover actions and inspect their full input/output schemas with `ox.service.inspect` before invoking them. Throws if the user's Action policy blocks or denies it, or if `requireAuth` and the user is not signed in; surface that error instead of retrying blindly.

input.description: Input matching the action's inputSchema returned by `ox.service.inspect`.

purpose.description: Short (<10 words) description shown to the user as the step label.

outputSchema.description: The action's output, which varies by the schema returned by `ox.service.inspect`.

ox.service.list.description: List all available services from enabled repositories, sorted by domain: `await ox.service.list({ purpose, kind? })`. Filter by `kind: "web"` for website services, `kind: "api"` for HTTP API services, `kind: "ios"` for device services, or `kind: "mcp"` for remote MCP servers. Every result includes its kind and current conversation attachment state. Returns every service without a result limit; omits action contracts. Disabled repositories are excluded.

purpose.description: Short (<10 words) description shown to the user as the step label.

outputSchema.description: Array of available service snapshots with domain, name, description when present, kind, signIn, saved, attached, and repository or MCP connection metadata when applicable.

ox.service.listAttached.description: List the services currently attached to this conversation: `await ox.service.listAttached({ purpose, kind? })`. Filter by `kind: "web"` for website services, `kind: "api"` for HTTP API services, `kind: "ios"` for device services, or `kind: "mcp"` for remote MCP servers. Every result includes its kind.

purpose.description: Short (<10 words) description shown to the user as the step label.

ox.service.pay.description: Hand final commitment to the user through an attached service's checkout: `await ox.service.pay({ purpose, domain, args })`. Prepare and price the pending cart, booking, or order first with the service's exposed actions. Pass the payment arguments required by that service. The user reviews and completes the payment on the service page; this function never commits payment itself. Resolves with the completed payment state and reference, and throws on cancellation, failure, or unsupported services.

args.description: Arguments shared by the service's payment URL and state actions.

purpose.description: Short (<10 words) description shown to the user as the step label.

outputSchema.description: The service's completed payment state, including its reference.

ox.service.signIn.description: Ask the user to sign in to an attached service and wait for completion: `await ox.service.signIn({ purpose, domain })`. Returns `{ domain, completed: true, signedIn, state, completion }`. `completion` distinguishes verified website sign-in, configured API credentials, authorized access, and user acknowledgment. When `completion` is `acknowledged`, sign-in remains unverified: load Evolve, inspect fresh session evidence, and repair a confirmed detector defect without reopening sign-in. One authenticated read may proceed in this caller for up to two minutes; mutations still require verified access. Inspect the result before continuing dependent work. API credential setup still needs an authenticated read to verify server acceptance. Throws when the user cancels, sign-in fails, or the service does not expose authentication.

purpose.description: Short (<10 words) description shown to the user as the step label.

ox.service.solve.description: Ask the user to complete a service's human verification and wait for completion: `await ox.service.solve({ purpose, domain, args })`. Inspect the service's `botControl` contract with `ox.service.inspect` and pass args matching its inputSchema. Resolves after successful verification so dependent JavaScript can continue. Throws when the user cancels or verification fails. Never ask for challenge answers or tokens.

purpose.description: Short (<10 words) description shown to the user as the step label.

ox.service.update.description:
Update an existing service by domain: `await ox.service.update({ purpose, domain, ...fields })`. Supported fields depend on the existing service kind; unsupported fields are rejected, and omitted fields are preserved. This never creates a missing service or changes its kind.

Local web services support name, description, baseUrl, faviconUrl, actions, and $defs. Local API services support those fields plus auth. Read the current manifest before updating. Arrays and objects replace the whole field, not merge; null removes optional description, faviconUrl, or $defs. Identity is fixed. Source updates validate the resulting manifest and write atomically but do not validate handlers or reload attachments. Edit actions.js and skill resources with ox.fs; finish the draft, call ox.service.validate, then ox.service.attach to load/reload. Changing API baseUrl or auth requires setup again. Credentials never belong in source. Bundled, Development, and Remote sources are read-only; copy eligible web/API services to Local before updating. Native services are read-only.

Local MCP connections support only endpoint, transport, and faviconUrl. MCP also accepts a connection name or unique endpoint host as domain. With no fields, reconnects and refreshes tools. Set transport to auto for detection. Set faviconUrl to a public HTTPS PNG, JPEG, or ICO URL, or null to restore server-advertised icons. Explicit icons load anonymously with up to five public HTTPS redirects; server-advertised icons remain same-site without redirects. Connection changes validate before replacing and save immediately; failure preserves the old connection. Changing endpoint keeps the domain but clears old local authorization and tool approvals. Tool contracts and implementation belong to the server and cannot be edited here. Other repositories' MCP definitions are read-only; copy them to Local before updating.

$defs.description: Replace Local web/API shared JSON Schema definitions; null removes them.

actions.description: Replace the complete Local web/API action declarations. Handlers remain in actions.js; edit them with ox.fs and validate before attaching.

auth.description: Replace Local API authentication configuration, never credentials. Supported objects: {type: 'none'}; {type: 'apiKey', in: 'header'|'query', name: '<header-or-query-name>'}; {type: 'http', scheme: 'basic'|'bearer'}; or {type: 'oauth2', flow: 'authorizationCode', authorizationURL: '<HTTPS URL>', tokenURL: '<HTTPS URL>', clientID: '<registered public client>', redirectURI: '<app callback URI>', scopes: ['<scope>'], pkce: 'S256'}. OAuth endpoints cannot contain credentials, query, or fragment; callback uses a non-HTTP app scheme without query or fragment. Requires setup again.

baseUrl.description: Local web execution URL or API HTTPS base URL. Web URLs must remain on the service domain or its subdomains.

description.description: Local web/API description; null removes it.

domain.description: Existing service domain. Direct MCP also accepts a saved connection name or unique endpoint host.

faviconUrl.description: Public HTTPS PNG, JPEG, or ICO URL. Local web/API and direct MCP support this field; null removes a Local override or restores MCP-advertised icons.

purpose.description: Short (<10 words) description shown to the user as the step label.

ox.service.validate.description: Validate a complete Local web or API service draft: `await ox.service.validate({ purpose, domain })`. Checks the manifest, action installer and matching action IDs, declared skills, required files, and service size limits together. Returns `{ domain, valid: true }` or throws with the validation error. Does not edit, attach, reload, Save, or invoke service actions. Finish related source edits before calling; individual file writes do not validate service contents.

purpose.description: Short (<10 words) description shown to the user as the step label.
